name: Kasukabe Masato
source:
An employee at a web design company.
He was a massive otaku back in university, but he hasn't had the time to indulge since entering the workforce, so his life is an empty one consisting of just work and sleep.
At some point, he discovered vtubers, and with them, a small amount of hope to cling to.
